title: 汇丰余晨登：美国限制收紧，内地半导体链反而受益？
speaker: Yu Chen-Deng

segments.en: So given tighter US restriction and also the universal AI hardware concern, so we would say the marginally,
segments.zh: 鉴于美国收紧限制及AI硬件的普遍担忧，我们认为边际上

segments.en: we do see more investment focuss into the domestic supply chain.
segments.zh: 确实看到更多关注投向本土供应链。

segments.en: The domestic semi supply chain getting more support, because just because of the stricter restriction, that kind of strengthens the local demand
segments.zh: 本土半导体供应链获得更多支持，因为更严格的限制强化了本地需求

segments.en: for the local substitution alternatives, although that might still near-term disruption, because the supply chain is still globally related.
segments.zh: 对本地替代方案的需求，尽管短期内可能仍有扰动，因为供应链仍全球关联。

segments.en: But from a narrative and also near-term demand perspective, it's getting much strengthened.
segments.zh: 但从叙事和近期需求角度看，正在大幅强化。

segments.en: And we would definitely highlight domestic semi-equipment makers, such as Nora and AMac, because we do see a very strong scope
segments.zh: 我们肯定重点关注本土半导体设备商，如北方华创和中微公司，因为看到非常强的空间

segments.en: for the domestic memory capacity addition, as well as the advanced or not foundry capacity addition
segments.zh: 用于本土存储产能扩张，以及先进或非先进代工产能扩张

segments.en: in a coming three to five years.
